faq.q: What is the origin of Soraya?
faq.a: Soraya is associated with Arabic. Soraya is Arabic ثُرَيَّا (Thurayyā), the name of the Pleiades star cluster.
Yes — the underlying form ثُرَيَّا is Arabic.
Soraya can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Soraya should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Thurayyā is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Soraya, soraya. Script forms are ثريا, ثریا, ثُرَيَّا, सुरैया.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
